summary: GDS Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K with its unaudited second quarter 2026 results. The filing is a routine earnings release, reporting net revenue of RMB3,088.0 million (up 6.5% year-over-year), net income of RMB837.6 million, and adjusted EBITDA of RMB1,406.0 million. Operating highlights include increased committed area and utilization rates. No special-situation transaction (acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, etc.) is disclosed. The filing is purely a standard periodic financial report and does not constitute a special situation.
